summary.name: Kaleidoscopic Animation. Category: Motion Design and Cinematography. Label normalized from an explicit kaleidoscope effect.
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: a pattern built around a fixed center and a deliberate number of mirrored sectors. Rotational speed, density, and palette stay coherent, and rotation or shape changes preserve symmetry. Artwork is replicated through rotated and mirrored sectors.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit good fits: psychedelic and demoscene imagery, infinite zoom and kaleidoscopic transitions, and surreal or abstract spatial passages. Inferred: ambient backgrounds, and music visuals or VJ loops when paired with a beat source. Poor fit where viewers must read dense text.
summary.limitations: Text must stay out of repeated sectors, so readable copy is constrained. Avoid center jumps and rapid flicker. Adapt or omit when stable orientation or reduced motion is required. A one-shot requirement may conflict with any unplanned reset. Source gives no fixed sector count or duration limit.
summary.palette: Suggested only, not supplied: background #201D32 (dark plum), foreground #F4E8D4 (cream), accent_1 #9E7FB9 (violet), accent_2 #5EA7A0 (teal), accent_3 #D8A169 (amber). Gradients are disabled, so use discrete tokens. Task or brand colors override these. Foreground on background is 13.513:1; accents against background range 4.824 to 7.186:1, but these are two-color checks only and must be verified on composited frames.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: rotation and shape changes maintain symmetry, with no center jumps or rapid flicker. Video motion should derive from shared composition time. Interactive delivery behavior is unspecified for this style, though pause control is suggested with a beat-driven pairing. Optional motion references are motion-002 (vortex passage) and motion-012 (chaptered handoff). Neither is required, and each needs scene validation.
summary.audio: Unspecified by the source for this style. Audio direction depends on the task. Inferred: music can drive sector changes on section boundaries and rotation accents on downbeats when paired with a beat map. Otherwise restrained ambience or silence fits. Tempo and mood are not fixed. If voiceover is added, speech intelligibility and picture sync must be verified.
summary.assetRequirements: No mandatory assets are specified. Inputs may include task-supplied subject, exact copy, exact colors, and artwork for sectors. An optional motif source is suggested. Fonts and assets must be loaded before rendering. Randomness should be seeded, and stateful simulations must be cached. Missing assets are unspecified and must be stated.
summary.combinations: Works alone for ambient visuals. Explicit suggestion: style-105 supplies beat-map timing, so sector count changes land on section boundaries and rotation accents on downbeats. Keep a fixed center and the plum, violet, teal, and gold palette, and avoid flicker. Explicit suggestion: style-006 supplies stepped deco motifs rotating inside mirrored sectors in gold accent, with a static fallback. Avoid indiscriminate gold sparkle.
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer: Canvas 2D for brushes and textures, or WebGL and GLSL for procedural shader imagery, selected by fidelity. Motion engine: GLSL, driving phase and rotation from one shared center and fixed symmetry parameters. Pipeline: HyperFrames by default (check, snapshot, render). Remotion only if HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists, with the reason recorded. Chroma-js is optional for contrast checks. Inspect opening, action, transition, and closing frames, then watch the decoded video.
